findings: Current video is regenerated; a generic regenerate-again recommendation does not address the observed offset.
Native Edge timings do not by themselves guarantee perceptually synchronized karaoke.
The sampled current file has an estimated combined word lead around150-165ms, with no evidence of growing audio drift across the six windows.
The Phase77 handoff did not run end-to-end synchronization checks; its unchanged native timing path should not have been taken as verified sync.
Further correction must distinguish measured codec/mux delay from acoustic/word presentation calibration; do not claim a fixed150ms offset is valid for every voice, rate and output.
Repair preserves provider captures and stored raw timings, adds one idempotent rate-aware calibration at audio-job reads, and rebuilds final AAC from composition sources before atomic publication.
Container alignment below1ms does not establish sub-millisecond word onset accuracy. Owner listening acceptance remains pending.

resolution.root_cause: Native Edge word onsets preceded approximate acoustic onsets by a rate-dependent amount; final Remotion AAC also added a measured42.5-42.75ms lag without growing drift.
